scientific_question: Does independently drawn destructive interference in recurrent memory increase cueing, source-separated attention allocation, and causal reliance on routing in a native 2x2 VDA4 model?

hypothesis.primary: Relative to memory_noise_std=0.0, training and testing with memory_noise_std=0.5 will increase the valid-versus-invalid behavioral cueing effect, sharpen cue- and target-aligned routing, and increase the behavioral consequence of spatially specific routing interventions.
hypothesis.signal_coherence_interpretation: If attention helps preserve and propagate task-relevant signals against independently corrupted memory traces, destructive interference should increase the value of selective routing. Support requires aligned behavioral, representational, and causal-use evidence rather than a training-accuracy difference alone.
null_or_disconfirming_patterns: the noise condition loses behavioral competence or produces a floor/ceiling that makes cueing uninterpretable
cueing changes only through criterion while sensitivity does not improve
attention becomes more extreme without better target localization or stronger spatially specific causal effects
effects disappear when the noise-trained checkpoint is evaluated with memory noise disabled
the seed-0 direction fails to replicate in a separately registered multi-seed extension

manipulation.unit: normalized xLSTM C/N_state units, where N_state is the xLSTM normalizer state and is unrelated to the native four-token count
manipulation.implementation: After each xLSTM cell update, when inject_memory_noise is true, C is replaced by C + memory_noise_std * (N_state + 1e-8) * randn_like(C). The code variable is named N; here it is written N_state to distinguish the recurrent normalizer from N_tokens=4. The perturbed C is carried to the next recurrent step.
manipulation.independence: torch.randn_like(C) draws one pseudorandom standard-normal value for every batch, native memory-slot, and memory-coordinate element at every injected update.
manipulation.scope: Noise is applied to the sole student/online xlstm used by crossattn1 during rollout collection and student replay optimization. The target actor/critic and JEPA EMA-teacher sequence passes remain noise-off even though those copied model objects carry the same sigma. Evaluation must explicitly report whether online noise injection is enabled.
manipulation.trainer_asymmetry: Registered and intentional for this pilot: ppo.collect_episodes injects noise into online rl_step; the optimized student sequence injects noise; target_model.forward_rl_sequence and jepa_teacher.forward_rl_sequence omit inject_memory_noise and therefore use deterministic recurrent updates. This experiment tests the current noisy-student/noise-off-teacher training algorithm, not an all-networks-noisy algorithm.
not_manipulated: number or width of memory slots
initial training RNG seed (subsequent on-policy trajectories may diverge)

pairing_contract.training_trace_limitation: The manipulation can change sampled actions and episode lengths. Because environment rendering and resets also consume RNG, the two on-policy training trajectories are not asserted to be common-random-number or bitwise identical after initialization. The held-out trial banks, not training, provide the true CRN comparison.
pairing_contract.failure_rule: The queue may stop only on an engineering or terminal-contract failure. It must never inspect cueing, attention, training accuracy, theta, or effect direction between conditions.
pairing_contract.paired_failure_disposition: If either member is interrupted or fails after the other member completes, preserve both unique directories but rerun the entire seed-0 pair fresh on one verified runtime for the registered comparison. Never splice a replacement condition together with the prior mate unless the original pair identity and exact runtime/GPU fingerprint contract are independently proven valid.
pairing_contract.inference_unit: one paired seed-0 pilot; directional and descriptive only

initial_environment_reset_diagnostic.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON for 32 consecutive VDA4 resets immediately after numpy.random.seed(0), with no intervening actions or rendered episode steps
initial_environment_reset_diagnostic.claim_boundary: This verifies the initial task RNG configuration only. It does not imply identical trial sequences during on-policy training.

required_checks: both levels construct the same 2209476 trainable parameters and identical named trainable initialization
the native grid is exactly 2x2 with four visual tokens and four recurrent memory slots
noise=0.0 is a functional no-op when injection is requested
noise=0.5 changes the carried C state, is reproducible under a reset torch RNG, and changes under a different RNG seed
all tensors and all 50 metric rows are finite
checkpoint and launch records bind the requested noise level, config, design, preflight, launcher, initial reset diagnostic, and source hashes

required_for_each_condition: exactly 20000 finite contiguous metrics rows with iter 0 through 19999
schema-3 rvit_paper_vda4_final.pt and rvit_plus_rl_latest.pt at iter 19999
finite semantic equality of final and latest checkpoint payloads
task vda4, native grid2x2, crossattn1, xlstm, d_mem128, memory_decay1, exact requested memory_noise_std, fresh seed0
exact resolved-config and experiment-launcher producer hashes
launch contract carries exact design, config, preflight, launcher, trainable-initialization, initial reset diagnostic, and source hashes
clean final-save log with no traceback
same pair id and runtime/GPU fingerprint across the two registered conditions
terminal_completion_contract.partial_or_interrupted_disposition: Preserve every unique directory. A nonterminal member cannot enter paired evaluation and must never be overwritten or silently resumed. If either member fails or is interrupted, preserve both attempts and rerun the full seed-0 pair fresh under one new pair identity and one verified runtime; do not splice a replacement with an earlier mate unless the original pair/runtime identity remains independently valid.

heldout_evaluation.prerequisite: Both registered runs pass terminal validation before any paired held-out result is inspected.
heldout_evaluation.factorial_cells: Evaluate both trained checkpoints at evaluation-time memory_noise_std=0.0 and 0.5, yielding the complete 2x2 train-noise by evaluation-noise factorial. The matched trained-condition contrast is train0/eval0 versus train0.5/eval0.5; noise-off and crossover cells distinguish learned compensation from acute corruption.
heldout_evaluation.mnemonic_draw_policy: Use exactly one independently drawn mnemonic-noise realization for each unique held-out sensory trial. Do not repeat the same sensory realization across multiple mnemonic draws. Share the exact trial identities, policy uniforms, and standard-normal mnemonic schedules across comparable factorial cells, and record their deterministic namespace-derived seeds and SHA-256 identities.

adaptive_nonsaturation_calibration.spatial_counterbalancing: At each magnitude, balance valid and no-change trials over all four cue locations and forced-invalid trials over all 12 ordered cue-to-distinct-change pairs.
adaptive_nonsaturation_calibration.selection_rule: Select one common focal magnitude once across all four train-noise by evaluation-noise cells using natural forced-invalid response rates. A magnitude is admitted only when every cell lies in [0.20,0.80]. Among admitted magnitudes choose the one minimizing mean squared distance from target response rate 0.60. If none is admitted, retain diagnostics at the angle with minimum maximum out-of-bounds distance and then minimum squared target distance, but mark the mechanistic interpretation gate failed. Freeze the selected common angle for every subsequent natural and intervention assay; never select per checkpoint or by the hypothesized effect direction.

psychometric_bank.validity_one_status: Forced-invalid trials at displayed validity 1.0 are an out-of-distribution expectancy-violation probe and are excluded from the primary in-distribution cue-validity slope/interaction.
psychometric_bank.spatial_counterbalancing: Balance cue locations over all four patches and forced-invalid targets over all 12 ordered distinct-location pairs within each validity/magnitude cell.

attention_bank.spatial_counterbalancing: Balance cue locations over all four native patches. For forced-invalid trials, balance all 12 ordered cue-to-distinct-change location pairs. Preserve pair identities across checkpoints with common random numbers.
attention_bank.registered_timing_contrasts: Measure cue-aligned allocation over frames 1-4 and true-change allocation over frames 5-6. On forced-invalid trials, report target-minus-cued-wrong allocation and postchange-minus-prechange reorientation separately for visual and recurrent-memory sources.
attention_bank.display: Always show visual-key and memory-key maps separately. A fused V+M display is secondary and must be labeled fused.

intervention_bank.intervention_formula: Beginning at frame 5, add key-logit bias b=6*(2*alpha-1) to the selected role and source keys. Thus alpha=0 is the registered -6 suppress endpoint, alpha=0.5 is zero-bias, and alpha=1 is the +6 boost endpoint. This additive hook does not implement routing-disabled and no result may be labeled as such.
intervention_bank.cued_wrong_control_definition: On forced-invalid trials the cued-wrong role is the cue location. On valid and no-change trials, where the cue and target-index fields coincide, cued-wrong is a deterministic non-target control location.
intervention_bank.spatial_counterbalancing: Apply every role, source, and dose across all four cue locations and all 12 ordered forced-invalid cue-to-change pairs. A fixed top-left cue to bottom-right change may be shown only as a labeled illustrative panel, never as the primary spatial estimate.

online_noise_modes.matched_trained_condition: Compare the noise0p0 checkpoint at evaluation noise 0.0 with the noise0p5 checkpoint at evaluation noise 0.5 using paired sensory trials, policy uniforms, and the single-draw-per-trial mnemonic schedule.
online_noise_modes.diagnostic_noise_off: Evaluate both trained checkpoints with injection disabled to test learned compensation and routing organization without acute stochastic corruption.
online_noise_modes.diagnostic_cross_over: Evaluate both checkpoints at both evaluation-noise levels. The train-noise by evaluation-noise interaction separates learned adaptation from acute stochastic corruption; it complements rather than replaces the matched trained-condition contrast.

behavior: primary in-distribution cue-validity slope and train-noise by evaluation-noise interaction over displayed validities 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75
valid-minus-invalid d-prime, with criterion reported separately
validity-1.0 forced-invalid expectancy-violation result reported separately as out-of-distribution
attention_allocation: visual-key and memory-key source shares by frame
source-conditional mass at cue, true-change, cued-wrong, and neutral locations
cue-aligned allocation at frames 1-4 and true-change allocation at frames 5-6
forced-invalid target-minus-cued-wrong and postchange-minus-prechange reorientation, separately for visual and memory sources
entropy, effective number of attended keys, top-one mass, and target-to-distractor ratio within each source
causal_use: natural-baseline versus additive key-logit-bias response rate and d-prime
role-by-source dose response across alpha 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.0
true-change alpha-1 boost minus alpha-0 suppress response rate and d-prime
spatial specificity relative to cued-wrong and neutral-control roles
primary_estimands.paired_contrast: For every estimand Y, report the matched trained-condition contrast Y_train0p5_eval0p5 - Y_train0_eval0 and the complete train-noise by evaluation-noise factorial contrasts on common-random-number trials. Use deterministic trial-stratified paired bootstrap confidence intervals. These intervals quantify held-out trial uncertainty conditional on seed 0; they are not across-seed population intervals.

attention_measurement_contract.native_shape: For N=4 crossattn1, A has N query rows and 2N key columns: four visual keys followed by four recurrent-memory keys.
attention_measurement_contract.physical_regions: Use the same physical 2x2 quadrants for all displays. In this native 2x2 pilot each region contains one patch.
attention_measurement_contract.regional_max: P_s(r)=max_{j in region r} p_s(j). In a native 2x2 grid, total and max are algebraically identical and must not be presented as independent converging measures.
attention_measurement_contract.normalization: Report raw mass, source-conditional mass, and uniform-normalized values. For crossattn1 with N=4, the raw-key uniform baseline is 1/(2N)=1/8.
attention_measurement_contract.aggregation: Preserve trial-level values and summarize paired trials; do not take a maximum over trials, heads, frames, or conditions unless that reduction is separately named.

spatial_inference_contract.primary: Location-counterbalanced average over the full native 2x2 grid.
spatial_inference_contract.forced_invalid_pairs: all 12 ordered pairs (cue, change) with cue != change
spatial_inference_contract.pairing: The same trial identity, cue/change locations, sensory realization, and evaluation-noise draw identifiers are used for both checkpoints.
spatial_inference_contract.fixed_example_limit: Top-left cue to bottom-right change is permitted only for intuitive visualization and must be labeled non-generalizing.

admission_gates.behavioral_competence: For every train-noise by evaluation-noise cell, require no-change false-alarm rate below 0.20, both policy actions observed, a positive forced-invalid response-rate slope from 3 to 30 degrees, and positive 30-degree forced-invalid d-prime. Failure is retained and reported as a competence failure.
admission_gates.nonsaturation: The one common focal magnitude must place natural forced-invalid response rate in [0.20,0.80] in every factorial cell. Otherwise maps and interventions are retained as gated diagnostics and cannot support a mechanistic interpretation.
admission_gates.attention_integrity: All attention values must be finite and each query distribution must sum to one within 1e-5.
admission_gates.paired_admission: No paired scientific comparison is allowed unless both conditions pass terminal artifact validation. Scientific gates may label an estimand non-informative but never delete or replace a condition.

interpretation_rules.pilot_support: The hypothesis receives seed-0 pilot support only if noise0p5 increases at least one sensitivity-corrected cueing estimand, increases target-selective source-separated routing at the registered frames, and increases a spatially specific causal-use contrast without competence or saturation failure.
interpretation_rules.attention_only: More concentrated or extreme attention without behavioral and causal alignment is descriptive reallocation, not support for signal coherence.
interpretation_rules.behavior_only: A cueing difference without source/time-specific routing and causal mediation does not establish attention as the mechanism.
interpretation_rules.criterion_only: A response-rate difference explained by criterion rather than d-prime does not support increased signal coherence.
interpretation_rules.replication_requirement: Any supportive seed-0 result must be followed by a separately frozen multi-seed replication before a general claim.

evidence_boundaries: Engineering canaries, training accuracy, curriculum theta, periodic checkpoints, GPU utilization, and process health are not attention, behavior, mechanism, or scaling evidence.
The two training runs are one paired seed and cannot establish a population effect.
Attention allocation is correlational unless accompanied by the registered spatially controlled intervention.
This pilot tests the native 2x2 VDA4 crossattn1 implementation only; it does not establish routing-family, discretization, set-size, biological, human, or primate generality.
A technically complete checkpoint that fails held-out competence remains a valid artifact but not usable evidence for the hypothesis.
